name: WatchYourLAN
description: A lightweight scanner that watches every device on your network.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: The app's SQLite database, settings file and scan history.

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: IFACES
variables.description: The network interface to scan, like eth0 or enp3s0. List more than one with a space between them. It must be a real interface name on this server.

variables.name: PORT
variables.description: The port the web UI uses. This app uses host networking, so this is the real port on your server. Keep it at 6121.
